name: Palo Alto Networks Cyberpedia Glossary
description: Palo Alto Networks Cyberpedia Glossary — vendor-published cybersecurity term glossary covering ~99 entries spanning network security, cloud security, endpoint protection, AI security, and related domains. Each entry pairs a concise definition with a deep-link to a longer per-term article on the Cyberpedia site.
relationToCloudSecurity: Direct — major terms in the glossary (CASB, CWPP, Cloud DLP, Cloud Security Posture, Zero Trust, SASE, BeyondCorp, etc.) are core cloud-security vocabulary.
relationToAISecurity: Direct — covers AI-relevant terms including AI security, Prisma AIRS, agentic AI risk concepts, ML-driven detection.

license.notes: Palo Alto Networks copyright. Internal CSA use only — extracted derivatives are not redistributable. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

lifecycle.notes: Rolling glossary, continuously updated by the publisher.

current_extraction.notes: HTML fetched via requests with browser-realistic UA; parsed with BeautifulSoup. 99 .glossary-card elements with .glossary-title selected; 1 duplicate removed (case-insensitive term key). Final term count: 98.

extraction_history.reason: Initial metadata stub created from glossary research sweep
First extraction landed in private repo — HTML scrape + parse to terms.csv/terms.json

notes: First proof-of-concept extraction under PROCESSING-GLOSSARIES.md workflow. Schema: term, definition, source_anchor, notes. Supplementary 'What I need to know about X' and 'Five FAQs about X' cards exist on the source page but are not modeled by the row-per-term schema; they can be added in a follow-up if needed.
